title: Weekend Recovery Surcharge — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
A recovery made on a weekend carries a weekend surcharge on its transport charge under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract. The surcharge follows the day of the week of the repossession date recorded on the contract.

| Day of the week of the repossession date | Weekend surcharge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | Sunday surcharge, $70.00 |
| Saturday | Saturday surcharge, $50.00 |
| Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday | none |

**Points of judgement**

- Only the repossession date decides the surcharge; the day the account was assigned and the day the vehicle reached the storage lot play no part in it.
- A recovery on a Sunday carries $70.00 and never the Saturday figure as well; a recovery falls on exactly one day of the week.
- Hypothetical: a vehicle recovered late on a Saturday evening and delivered on the Sunday has a Saturday repossession date and carries $50.00.
